honest_c3: RunPod CLI 2.x removed the prior --cost ceiling and interruptible/spot flags. Current `pod create` does not let you bid a max price; it accepts the SKU's market rate or returns inventory-empty. This means no programmatic guarantee against accidentally booking on-demand vs spot at this CLI level — must verify SKU sub-variant and pricing column before commit.

Static `runpodctl get cloud` listings show H100 PCIe community is NOT in community price table at all — only HBM3 ($1.50 spot) and NVL ($1.40 spot). The '$1.99 community PCIe' figure from prior verdict was likely a probe-error stub, not a stable price.

Datacenter inventory listings (from `runpodctl datacenter list`) show H100 PCIe in CA-MTL-3 (low) and US-KS-2 (empty), but those listings don't separate community vs secure cloud. Probes confirm community is empty in both DCs.

Last failed launch (t16bppyyw2xcax @ $2.39 SECURE) appears to have happened because the prior subagent omitted --cloud-type COMMUNITY (default is SECURE in CLI 2.x). Future launches MUST explicitly set --cloud-type COMMUNITY.
Account balance is $314.69, well above the $20 cap. spendLimit on the account is $80 — additional safety net beyond task cap.
Path A pod 29dhlqk508ugoc untouched; cost continues at $2.99/hr unrelated to this task.
